config.evaluation: subject-grouped 5-fold CV, identical folds for both configurations
config.note: StratifiedGroupKFold ignores feature values, so both configurations share the same folds and subjects; only the feature set differs.

documentation.acoustic_only_752: gender removed from the Baseline block; acoustic measurements only.
documentation.acoustic_plus_gender_753: gender retained in the Baseline block as demographic metadata; identical feature set to the deployed model.
documentation.deployed_model: The deployed 753-feature model was fit on a single fixed subject split and is NOT retrained or altered here. These cross-validated estimates measure generalisation and do not represent the deployed model's reported numbers.
documentation.gender_treatment: demographic metadata, not an acoustic feature group.
